The '''Siege of Boten''' was a major urban battle during the [[Nogoyevian War of Independence]]. It was fought for [[Boten]], a coastal industrial city south of [[Migov]].

Zhensanovian forces attempted to capture Boten to disrupt Nogoyevian supply lines and secure a coastal foothold. Nogoyevian defenders fortified factories, warehouses, streets, and port infrastructure.

== Course ==

The siege lasted four weeks. Zhensanovian artillery and airstrikes failed to break the defenses, while Nogoyevian snipers, small units, and fortified industrial positions imposed heavy losses on attackers.

The Union eventually withdrew. The failure to take Boten, combined with the failure at Migov, showed that Zhensanov could not easily capture Nogoyev's major metropolitan centers.
